turns.query: Across 2020 through 2025, what was the highest single hourly nitrogen dioxide reading anywhere in Hong Kong's air quality monitoring network, and where and when was it recorded?

Hong Kong's Air Quality Objective for nitrogen dioxide sets an hourly limit of 200 ug/m3 and permits 18 exceedances of it in a calendar year. Over those same six years, how many of them did Hong Kong not meet that objective?
The desk wants to write that Hong Kong's nitrogen dioxide problem is city-wide. Is it, and what would have to change for it to go away?
